record.body:
## Description

R25: The existing leaf-view overlay tests pass unchanged.

Fix the reviewer finding: bare requirement ids in claim text must keep linking on the effort page and in the needs, backlog and record modals.

## Approach

Restore the link context on routes that have no phase of their own. Write the test first, then the fix.

- Add `src/lib/screens/linkContext.test.ts` (jsdom, mount `App` as in `src/lib/screens/areas.test.ts`). One test titled exactly `R25 a bare requirement id in a Needs you claim on the effort page links to the default phase`: an effort with a default phase and a Needs-you row whose claim text contains `R3`; the effort page shows an anchor to `#/requirement/<effort>/<default phase>/R3` inside the row. A second test titled `R25 a bare requirement id in a needs modal links to the default phase` does the same inside the needs modal opened at `#/needs/<effort>/<id>`. Confirm both fail before the fix, on an assertion.
- Fix `linkCtx` in `src/lib/state/overlay.svelte.ts`: when `routePhase` is null, use the default phase of the effort in view (`defaultPhase` or `resolvedPhase(effort, null)` from `src/efforts.ts`), as `polling.phaseSubject` did before it was removed. Routes that resolve a phase keep the route phase.
- Touch no frozen or pinned test (`phasePage`, `phaseNav`, `phaseTasks`, `phaseLeaf`, `effortPhaseRows` tests, `e2e/app.spec.ts`, `detail.test.ts`, `deepLinks.test.ts`, `detailNav.test.ts`, `detailView.test.ts`, `dialogs.test.ts`).
- Close with `npm run lint`, `npm run check`, `npm test`.

payload.title: Restore the default phase link context
